subject: Export file naming convention
body: Is there a way to customise the file naming convention for scheduled exports? Currently they all download as 'export_1.csv', 'export_2.csv' and so on, which makes it hard to tell them apart once several have landed in the same folder. Ideally we'd want the report name and date included automatically. Mikael

subject: Connector setup for new CRM
body: We've switched CRM providers and need to set up a new data connector to replace the old one. Could you send over the setup guide, or let us know if this needs to be configured from your side? Separately, we did look briefly at Storsund BI during the CRM transition since we were reviewing several vendor relationships at once, but decided to stick with Kataja for now. Emma

subject: Unused seat from the CRM transition
body: Following on from the CRM changeover in the autumn, we still have one seat assigned to a role that no longer exists in our new setup. Could you remove it, or let us know if it's simpler for us to just leave it unassigned until renewal? Not pressing, just tidying up loose ends from that project. Mikael

subject: New starter has no dashboard access
body: New starter still shows no dashboard access after we added his seat on Monday. He's sitting idle waiting. Need this fixed today please.

subject: Salesforce connector dropped again
body: Salesforce connector dropped overnight - third time this month. Reauthorized it but it won't hold.

subject: API key rotated without warning
body: You rotated our API key last week and nobody told us - the integration has been silently failing since. Not acceptable for an Enterprise account.

subject: Ops dashboard showing stale numbers
body: The pivot widget on our ops dashboard is showing last month's figures. Already cleared cache and refreshed twice.

subject: PDF export blank again
body: PDF export came out completely blank again this morning. Thought this was already fixed.

subject: Same widget bug, second dashboard now
body: Same stale-data widget issue as yesterday, now showing up on a second dashboard too. Please escalate to whoever actually owns this.

subject: Widget bug back
body: Widget bug is back. Please just fix it properly this time.

subject: Export corrupted again
body: Export corrupted again this morning. This keeps happening and it's costing us time every time.

subject: Offboarded user still has access
body: We offboarded someone two weeks ago and their access is still active. That's a security risk - please deactivate now, not queued.

subject: Connector down again
body: Connector's down again, same Salesforce auth issue as before. Feels like we're doing your reauth job for you.

subject: Exports timing out on large reports
body: Now exports are timing out on our larger reports. Second issue today.

subject: Connector dropped overnight, again
body: Connector dropped overnight again. We need a permanent fix here, not another reauth band-aid.

subject: API throwing 401s since this morning
body: API's been throwing 401s since this morning. Nothing changed on our end.

subject: Seat count wrong on account page
body: Our account page shows two fewer seats than we're actually paying for. Please correct the count.

subject: Connector auth issue, yet again
body: Connector auth issue again. I feel like I send this exact ticket every quarter.

subject: Duplicate alert emails
body: Getting duplicate alert emails, sometimes three or four for the same trigger. Please check the notification logic.

subject: Still duplicating
body: Still duplicating. Please confirm the fix actually went out on our instance.

subject: Widget bug, third time this year
body: Widget bug is back for the third time this year. At this point can we get a permanent fix logged instead of another patch?

subject: Dashboard access for new regional finance leads
body: We've appointed three new regional finance leads and would like each to have access to their own region's dashboard only, not the consolidated group view. Could you confirm the best way to set this up — separate dashboard copies with filters, or a permissions-based approach on the existing consolidated dashboard? We'd like this ready before their first monthly close at the end of the month. Hanna

subject: Alert emails landing in spam for some recipients
body: Two of the three regional leads set up in August have mentioned that alert emails from the platform are landing in their spam folder rather than the inbox, while the third receives them fine. All three are on the same corporate email domain, so I'm not sure what's different. Could you check the sending configuration, or advise on an SPF/DKIM setting we might need to adjust on our end? Hanna

subject: Seat licence count ahead of Q1 headcount changes
body: We're planning some headcount changes across the regional teams in January and want to understand how seat billing works if we add and remove several licences within the same month — is it prorated, or billed at the higher watermark? Asking now so we can plan properly, and also because Dashlume's Enterprise pricing model came up for comparison during a recent budget conversation, so it would help to understand ours clearly either way. Hanna

subject: Regional dashboard access issue since August
body: Circling back on the regional dashboard access set up in August — one of the three regional leads has been able to see figures from a different region than her own since the changeover, something we only caught during January's close review. We've restricted her access manually as a stopgap while the underlying permissions get sorted. Given the scale of our rollout, I'd like confidence this is properly fixed rather than patched again, though I recognise it isn't causing daily disruption at this point. Hanna

subject: Bulk seat setup for new finance hires
body: Setting up seats for three new finance hires ahead of month-end close. Support walked us through the bulk import option, worked smoothly - thank you.

subject: Request: webhook on report completion
body: Would it be possible to get a webhook that fires when a scheduled report finishes generating? Would let us trigger downstream jobs automatically. Turned around same day - impressive.

subject: Export scheduling for quarter close
body: Needed a one-off export schedule change for quarter close and support had it sorted within a few days without us having to chase. Nice to deal with.

subject: Dashboard layout question
body: Wanted to check if nested tabs are possible on a single dashboard for different regions. Support pointed us to a setting we hadn't found - works well, thanks.

subject: API pagination behaving oddly on large pulls
body: Noticed pagination skipping records on pulls above 10k rows. Support tracked it to a cursor edge case and got it patched within the week.

subject: Request: incremental sync option for warehouse connector
body: Full syncs on our warehouse connector are getting slow as the dataset grows. Any chance of an incremental sync mode? Got a workable answer within a few days.

subject: Conditional formatting in report builder
body: Asked whether report builder supports conditional formatting rules like a spreadsheet would. Not there yet, but support gave us a decent workaround and logged it as a request.

subject: Multi-condition alert setup
body: Wanted an alert that only fires when two metrics breach thresholds together, not either one alone. Took a couple of weeks since it needed a proper build, but the end result works exactly as we hoped.

subject: Incremental sync working well
body: The incremental sync option from a few months back is running smoothly now that we've tuned the window. Just flagging one edge case with late-arriving rows, which support cleared up quickly.

subject: Connector question ahead of new data source
body: Planning to add a new source next quarter and wanted to confirm connector limits per workspace beforehand. Support gave a clear answer fast.

subject: Dashboard replacing our monthly Excel pack
body: We've finally retired the monthly Excel pack in favour of a live dashboard - just needed help getting the layout to match what leadership was used to. Support got it there in a few days, good result.

subject: Dashboard drill-down question
body: Following on from last week - can we set drill-down on the same dashboard so clicking a region opens the detail view? Sorted quickly.

subject: Second dashboard for regional teams
body: Building a second dashboard for the regional teams based on the one we just set up. Took a bit longer since we kept adding requirements mid-build, but happy with where it landed.

subject: Request: save report builder templates
body: Would be useful to save a report builder layout as a reusable template rather than rebuilding each time. Support confirmed it's on the way and gave us an interim workaround.

subject: API access for a read-only integration
body: Asked about a read-only API key we could hand to an external auditor without exposing write access. Took under a week to get a proper scoped key set up.

subject: Role-based dashboard visibility
body: Wanted certain dashboards hidden from specific seat roles rather than everyone seeing everything. Support configured it directly for us.

subject: Export template for board pack
body: Needed a custom export template matching our board pack branding. Took a few rounds of tweaks but the final version is exactly what we wanted.

subject: Seat renewal - sticking with Kataja
body: Looked at Dashlume during our renewal review mainly for the role-based visibility feature, but since you shipped that a couple of months ago there wasn't much reason to switch. Just needed help adjusting seat counts for the new term - quick turnaround.

subject: Report builder templates - follow-up
body: The saved template feature from April is working well now that it's fully rolled out. One request for a nested template option took a bit longer to sort but got there in the end.

subject: Licence renewal — seat count question
body: Hello, our subscription is up for renewal next month and I want to confirm how many seats are currently active versus how many we are licensed for. The Admin panel shows a number but I am not sure if deactivated users are counted. Could you clarify the seat count methodology and confirm our current usage? Best regards, Juha Back.

subject: SSO configuration — SAML setup question
body: Hello, we are setting up SAML-based SSO for our team. I have followed the documentation but the IdP metadata import step does not seem to work — the file uploads but the configuration does not save. Could you advise on the supported metadata format and whether there are known compatibility issues with Azure AD as the identity provider? Thank you, Juha Back.

subject: Dashboard not loading after browser update
body: Hello, after a Chrome update our dashboards are not loading correctly — widgets show a loading spinner that does not resolve. Clearing cache did not help. This is happening on multiple machines. Is there a known compatibility issue with the latest Chrome version? Thank you, Juha Back.

subject: Scheduled export didn't run
body: Scheduled export didn't run last night. No error, no file, nothing in the log.

subject: API throttling below documented limit
body: Getting throttled on API calls well below the documented rate limit. Blocking our overnight batch jobs.

subject: Dashboard load times unacceptable
body: Dashboards are taking 20+ seconds per tab to load this week. Completely unusable for the morning standup.

subject: Same slow load issue as last month
body: Same slow-load issue as August. Did the fix actually ship, or did it regress?

subject: Dashboards down before board meeting
body: Dashboards are down entirely this morning and we have a board meeting in two hours. Need this fixed now.

subject: Alert thresholds reset overnight
body: Alert thresholds reset themselves overnight again. Third time this has happened.

subject: Can't remove a departed employee's seat
body: Trying to remove a departed employee's seat and getting an error every single time. Need it gone before month-end billing.

subject: Alerts not firing at all
body: Alerts haven't fired since yesterday. Nobody got notified about the overnight spike we were tracking for.

subject: Alerts now firing twice
body: Alerts were fixed yesterday, now they're firing twice for each trigger. Please get this stable, this is the second issue in two days.

subject: Intermittent API failures
body: API calls have been failing intermittently since this morning, no clear pattern I can find.

subject: Warehouse connector stopped syncing
body: Same day, different bug - the connector to our warehouse just stopped syncing, no error message.

subject: API 500 errors on reports endpoint
body: Getting 500 errors on the reports endpoint since last night.

subject: Exports queued but never completing
body: Exports are queuing but never completing. Same day as the API errors - are these related?

subject: Third ticket today - connector sync failed
body: Third ticket from me today. Connector sync failed as well now. Is something broken platform-wide?

subject: Dashboard tiles showing stale data
body: Dashboard tiles are showing stale data again, cache isn't refreshing on schedule.

subject: Still stale this morning
body: Still showing stale data this morning. Please confirm the fix actually deployed to our instance.

subject: Export files have wrong date range
body: Export files are coming out with the wrong date range. Started today, wasn't an issue last week.

subject: Date range bug is back
body: Date range bug is back on exports. Same issue as two days ago.

subject: Exports still wrong
body: Exports still wrong. Third report this week with the wrong date range.

subject: Report builder crashes on second data table
body: Report builder crashes every time I add a second data table to a report. Fully reproducible on my end, happy to send steps.

subject: API integration broke overnight
body: API integration broke again overnight, same error code as before.

subject: Report builder still crashing
body: Report builder is still crashing on multi-table reports. Please prioritize this - it's holding up year-end reporting.

subject: Connector failed too, same day
body: Connector failed as well, same day as everything else. Bad timing given it's year-end.

subject: Crashed again
body: Crashed again. Fourth time today. Please just fix it.

subject: Alert setup — condition logic question
body: Hello, I am setting up an alert and need to understand how compound conditions work. Can I combine AND and OR conditions in a single alert rule, or is each alert limited to a single condition? The documentation is not clear on this. Thank you, Pekka Eriksen.

subject: Export to SFTP — is this supported?
body: Hello, we would like to deliver scheduled exports to an SFTP server rather than by email. Is SFTP delivery supported, and if so where is it configured? Thank you, Pekka Eriksen.

subject: API: how to retrieve historical metric snapshots?
body: Hello, I am trying to retrieve daily snapshots of a metric over the past 12 months via the API. The current endpoint returns the latest value. Is there a historical or time-series endpoint, or a way to query point-in-time values? Pekka Eriksen.

subject: Report builder crashing on large dataset
body: Hello, the report builder is crashing (page reload) when I try to load a report that includes our largest data source (~500k rows). Smaller datasets work fine. This has happened consistently this week. Could you advise on whether there is a known row limit in the report builder preview, and whether there is a workaround? Pekka Eriksen.

subject: Alert not triggering — condition met but no notification
body: Hello, I have an alert configured to fire when a metric falls below 50. I can see the metric is at 43 in the dashboard but no notification was sent. I have checked the recipient list and the condition — both look correct. Could you investigate? This is the second time an alert has not fired as expected and I am starting to lose confidence in the alert module. Pekka Eriksen.

subject: API rate limits causing pipeline failures
body: Hello, our integration is hitting API rate limits during our daily sync window. Our usage is within what I would consider reasonable for our account size. I raised a question about the rate limit documentation back in July and the answer I received was vague. I need concrete numbers for the limits per endpoint and a clear explanation of how they are enforced, or our pipeline work cannot continue. Pekka Eriksen.

subject: Exports completely broken — nothing has worked for two weeks
body: Hello. Our scheduled exports stopped working on approximately 20 November. I have raised this twice through the support portal with no substantive response. This is now affecting our month-end reporting process. We generate six reports that go directly to our finance team and all six are failing silently — no error, no email, no file. I should not have to submit a third ticket to get a response on something this fundamental. The API rate limit issue from October is also still unresolved. I would like both issues addressed, not just acknowledged. Pekka Eriksen.

subject: Dashboard data stale — still showing December figures
body: Hello. It is 9 January and our dashboards are still displaying data from late December. Connector syncs show as successful in the log. The dashboard is not picking up new data. We have had exports failing, rate limit issues, and now stale dashboards. I find it increasingly difficult to explain to my colleagues why basic functions are not working. Pekka Eriksen.

subject: User locked out — cannot reset via admin panel
body: Hello, one of our analysts is locked out of their account after too many failed login attempts. The admin panel shows a 'Reset' option but clicking it does nothing. I have tried this in two browsers. Could you unlock the account and fix the reset button? We have several open issues at the moment and this adds to the list. Pekka Eriksen.

subject: Connector error on schema update
body: Hello, we added a column to one of our source tables and the connector started failing. I have been through this kind of thing before with the API rate limits and dashboard issues. I know you will fix it eventually — could you just confirm the steps for refreshing the connector schema so I can do it myself next time if possible. Thank you, Pekka Eriksen.

subject: Report builder — filter options missing for one dataset
body: Hello, the filter panel in the report builder is not showing filter options for one of our datasets. Other datasets work normally. I have checked the connector and the data is there. This is probably a configuration issue on your end. Please look into it when you get a chance — we have a workaround in place for now. Thank you, Pekka Eriksen.

subject: Alert digest not sending — again
body: Hello. The daily alert digest has not been delivered for the past three days. This is the same issue as before — it resolves and then comes back. I have stopped relying on it for operational monitoring and we are using a manual process instead. Please fix it when possible. Pekka Eriksen.

subject: Export format doesn't match our template
body: We're finalizing our reporting stack after comparing Kataja against Storsund BI, and this export format mismatch needs sorting before we can commit fully - the column order doesn't match our finance template.

subject: Dashboard filter gap vs. what we saw elsewhere
body: One thing that came up again while we compare notes against Storsund BI - we can't filter a dashboard by a custom date range, only preset periods. Is that on a roadmap somewhere?

subject: Coming back to the export template issue
body: Coming back to this - the export template mismatch from last year is still causing manual rework for finance. We ultimately stayed with Kataja over Storsund BI, so would like this properly fixed rather than worked around.

subject: Alert setup question after a Dashlume demo
body: Sat through a Dashlume demo last week as part of a routine vendor review - their alert builder looked a bit more flexible. Is there a way to chain conditions in our alerts, or is that still single-condition only?

subject: Export scheduling follow-up
body: Following up on the alert question from last month - separately, could scheduled exports support multiple recipients with different formats? Dashlume apparently offers that, curious if it's on your side too.

subject: Alert not triggering on threshold breach
body: Set up an alert for when weekly sales drop below target but it didn't trigger last week despite the breach. Can you check the config?

subject: Alert still not triggering
body: Following up - the alert from last month is still not triggering consistently. Worked twice, missed twice.

subject: New connector for warehouse data
body: Setting up a new connector to our data warehouse - ran into an auth error partway through setup, wanted to check the correct scopes before retrying.

subject: Seat transfer for role change
body: One of our analysts is moving to a different team - can we transfer their seat and saved dashboards to a new login rather than starting fresh?

subject: Connector sync failing for over a week
body: Our main connector has been failing intermittently for over a week now and it took several follow-ups just to get someone looking at it. Reports are running on partial data in the meantime.

subject: API errors on top of the connector trouble
body: Now getting API errors as well. Feels like we're chasing a different issue every month since the connector problems in August.

subject: Connector issue is back, unresolved
body: The connector issue from August is back and this time nobody has picked it up in three days. We can't keep running reports on stale data.

subject: Seat provisioning broken, connector STILL open
body: On top of the connector ticket that's still open, now seat provisioning is failing for a new hire too. This account needs proper attention, not one-off fixes.

subject: Requesting escalation on the connector saga
body: This connector issue has now been open, on and off, since August. I'd like to request a proper escalation - someone senior on your side reviewing the whole history, not another individual ticket fix.

subject: Alerts broken too - still waiting on real answers
body: Alerts have stopped firing reliably now as well. Given everything since last August, I'd like this looked at by someone who can actually see the full picture, not just close individual tickets.

subject: Dashboard fix confirmed after the call
body: Following the call last month, the dashboard sync issue is genuinely fixed - checked it daily for two weeks now. Appreciate someone finally looking at the whole picture instead of individual tickets.

subject: Second dashboard confirmed fixed too
body: Same for the second dashboard we flagged - stable since the fix went out. Thank you.

subject: Connector running smoothly
body: Wanted to say the connector has been solid since the escalation in the spring - first real stretch without an issue since last August.

subject: Alerts stable too
body: Alerts are holding up well too. Good to have a quiet month for once.

subject: Minor API question
body: Quick question on API rate limits for a new integration we're planning - nothing urgent, just want to plan capacity correctly.

subject: Export layout tweak
body: Could we adjust the export layout slightly to match a new internal template? Small change, not urgent.

subject: Routine seat addition
body: Adding two seats for new hires starting in January - just confirming the process ahead of time.
